purpose: Generate three independently authored, glance-readable core special-expression sources. This is source art only: it is not a runtime resource, CRIG, profile, firmware binding, panel frame, or acceptance claim.
owner_readability_contract: At a native 200x200 static hold and without a label, legend, surrounding UI or motion, menu_active, recording_active and charging_active must be distinguishable from each other at a glance. The complete face carries the primary functional-action reading; any accent is only a secondary reinforcement.
identity_invariants: retain the locked V9 open-eye silhouette, pupil fills, one primary highlight and one small sparkle per eye
retain the locked V9 eye-pair scale, spacing, baseline, nose anchor and monochrome black-ink treatment
do not make a new eye shape, eyelash, iris, pupil, colour treatment, face outline or full-face card
every brow, mouth, cheek and accent mark must be a separately extractable source component inside a 200x200 export-safe face area
use a clean pure-white background with no text, label, legend, UI panel, button, screen frame or layout grid
do not add a literal menu icon, microphone, waveform, battery, plug, lightning symbol, question, exclamation, heart, star or emoji

poses.functional_read: purposeful browse/select attention, not generic thinking or surprise
poses.face_primary: Use an obviously intentional, composed selection pose: both brows make a firm but friendly inward focus, the mouth is a compact decisive closed selection mark rather than an open surprised O, and the cheeks stay contained. It must look meaningfully more purposeful than Daily before any accent is seen.
poses.accent_secondary: Use only a compact detached three-step dot cadence above the face, with clear spacing and enough visual weight to reinforce controlled navigation. It must not form a literal menu control or UI glyph.
poses.choreography_intent: Daily highlight pickup, two-stage brows settle inward, mouth lands on the selection pose, dot cadence enters once, then an explicit causal reverse on menu exit.

poses.functional_read: unmistakable active listening/responding, not generic excitement or decoration
poses.face_primary: Use a clearly receptive listening pose: brows visibly lift and angle toward the center with alert softness, the mouth becomes a small rounded attentive response mark, and the cheek marks become visibly alert. The pose must read as listening from the face alone before surrounding marks are seen.
poses.accent_secondary: Use two balanced, bold but compact nested listening arcs outside the cheeks. They reinforce an already readable listening face and must not resemble a microphone, waveform or UI notification.
poses.choreography_intent: Legal highlight orient, brow-listen settle, one paired ripple expands and retracts, then an explicit causal reverse on recording stop or cancel.

poses.functional_read: clear replenishing, restful relief, not generic joy or sleep
poses.face_primary: Use an unmistakably restorative contented pose: brows relax upward and outward, the mouth forms a clearly visible soft upward satisfied smile, and cheeks look gently buoyant. The face alone must read as relief and recovery, not a generic Daily smile.
poses.accent_secondary: Use two detached, rounded upward breathing marks above the face with a larger, calm rhythm than the menu dots. They reinforce replenishment without forming a battery, plug or lightning symbol.
poses.choreography_intent: Highlights soften, brows release, satisfied mouth settles, breathing marks rise once and settle, then an explicit causal reverse when charging ends.

required_followup: generate one clean source image per pose using only the locked V9 reference
archive each exact prompt, generated source path and SHA-256 before crop, normalization or component export
reject a source whose face alone reads as Daily, whose intent relies on its accent alone, or whose accent is a literal UI/status icon
prove native 200x200 static-hold output, face-primary deltas across all three poses and browser/target component-plan parity before a canonical owner-art review
keep every V24 resource runtime inactive and unbound until owner art review and the separate physical White/Black gates pass
